title: AxionLimitBench prediction (one paper)
description: What a system emits per paper. The scorer keys on arxiv_id and reads coupling_type, is_new_limit, is_projection, data_points and coupling_convention; the rest is metadata kept for analysis. Unknown keys (e.g. a `meta` block) are ignored by the scorer.

arxiv_id.description: Canonical arXiv identifier, e.g. 2208.07293 or hep-ph/0307284

is_new_limit.description: The paper reports its own measured exclusion on one of the couplings

is_projection.description: Forecast / sensitivity projection rather than a measured limit

data_points.description: Boundary of the excluded region as [mass_eV, coupling] pairs in the canonical plane for coupling_type (see docs/TASK.md). Empty when abstaining.

dm_density_assumed.description: Local DM density assumed by the paper in GeV/cm^3, null if the limit does not depend on it

coupling_convention.description: Free-text declaration of the variable and units actually emitted, e.g. 'g_agamma [GeV^-1]'

meta.description: System/run provenance (transport, model billed, cost, turns, audit flags). Not read by the scorer.
